resolutions.researcher_notes: Searched Aramco MGS-3 Yanbu-Rabigh completion timing. StartYear1=2028 is supported as the project completion/start-up year: BlackRidge project profile states 'Project Completion Date: Q4 2028' (construction commenced Q2 2024). JPT/SPE trade report independently states the expansion raises capacity 'by an additional 3.15 Bcf/D by 2028'. Two independent sources agree on 2028. The original Aramco press release (dead as live link, ReadTimeout) also verifies via Wayback and supports the 2028 timeline.

Diameter=20,16,12,4 in exactly matches BlackRidge Package 15 scope: 'Lay various diameter lateral pipelines (20-inch, 16-inch, 12-inch, 4-inch) from Yanbu to Rabigh (192km).' The MEED coverage (current_ref, paywalled/dead) carries the same figures but its content cannot be independently verified. DMSprojects has a dedicated Package 15 'Yanbu to Rabigh Pipeline' record but its specs are login-walled, so it corroborates the route but not the diameters. Single verifiable source for the diameter values -> medium.

StartPrefecture/District=Yanbu -> EndPrefecture/District=Rabigh (both Saudi Arabia) confirmed by two independent sources: BlackRidge ('...from Yanbu to Rabigh (192km)') and DMSprojects, which maintains a discrete 'Package 15 - Yanbu to Rabigh Pipeline' project record. Yanbu is in Al Madinah province and Rabigh in Makkah province, consistent with the stated StartState/Province and EndState/Province.

Owner1=Aramco 100% strongly supported. JPT/SPE: 'Aramco announced 15 lump-sum turnkey contracts worth about $8.8 billion' for MGS Phase 3. BlackRidge: MGS-3 'owned by Saudi Aramco.' The Aramco press release itself (current_ref; dead as live URL, ReadTimeout but verifies via Wayback) is the primary confirmation. MGS is Aramco's wholly-owned national gas backbone; no third-party equity found -> 100% Aramco stands. Two-plus independent sources -> high.
